goldens.input: How long can I restore a deleted note?
goldens.reference_answer: Admins can restore a deleted note from the Trash within 30 days.

goldens.input: How much does the Pro plan cost?
goldens.reference_answer: Pro costs $8 per user per month and includes unlimited notes.

goldens.input: Does Product One support SMS alerts?
goldens.reference_answer: The Product One documentation does not mention SMS alerts, so it cannot be confirmed.
